posts.title: Woshibai
posts.description: One of my favourite comics artists working today is Woshibai (Tumblr) , based in Shanghai. I can't remember where I first came across his drawings, but I have been following his Tumblr for a very long time. His style is very minimalist but precise, usually one or two panels, each with a gnomic caption. Occasionally he posts slightly longer stories too. His books have mostly been published by Frenc
